name: IntelQCopter small software lessons
architecture: ESP32-S3 standalone FC target 1000 Hz; single Arduino main.cpp; staged hardware validation

status.description: Show acceptance state for the small lessons

gate.description: Record pass/fail/build evidence and inspect validation

build.description: Compile only the current small lesson, preserving output

capture.description: Legacy passive 115200-baud receiver; current lesson uses record-bias-x at 921600 baud

upload.description: Manually upload bench firmware; add --upload-port COMx

check-gates.description: Test failure/staleness behaviour in temporary synthetic fixtures only

repair.description: Start from a failed step implementation checkpoint, excluding its later descendants

check-accel.description: Historical corrected-firmware expression check; not applicable to the current raw capture firmware

imu-noise.description: Calculate candidate IMU noise statistics from an original saved stationary serial log; no serial connection

record-poses.description: Automatically save 18 20-second MPU FIFO recordings, prompting before every pose; never uploads

check-pose-recorder.description: Synthetic recording protocol tests; no board, serial port, or upload

analyze-poses.description: Verify and analyze a completed 18-pose session offline; save derived report and graphs in a new folder

check-pose-analysis.description: Analytic/synthetic calibration and covariance checks; no hardware

record-tilts.description: Record four 45-degree tilt poses, prompting and saving automatically; no upload

check-tilt-recorder.description: Check tilt-reference geometry and synthetic capture/resume flow; no board

analyze-tilts.description: Verify tilted-pose originals and compare frozen calibration using explicit operator-confirmed raised sides

check-tilt-analysis.description: Known-vector checks of reference signs and wrong-axis differences; no hardware

record-bias-x.description: Historical X-only protocol; not for current IMU_XYZ_V1 firmware

check-bias-x.description: Analytic drift/phase-timing checks for X-bias comparison; no sensor or emulator

record-accel.description: Historical ACCEL_XYZ_V1 recorder for its matching source checkpoint; current IMU_XYZ_V1 uses record-gyro

check-accel-xyz.description: Source-coefficient float32 algebra and protocol checks for full XYZ; not MCU/hardware execution

analyze-accel.description: Verify original MCU XYZ logs, register metadata and per-sample matrix output; save derived report and graphs, no refit

record-gyro.description: Historical V1/V2/V3 recorder and verified local historical-commit capture; current FIFO firmware uses record-1khz

check-gyro-observation.description: Offline IMU packet conversion, held-out statistics and full acceleration checks; no hardware

analyze-gyro.description: Offline original-log verification and frozen-bias review of three 60-second gyro runs; no serial or firmware change

check-gyro-bias.description: Source-coefficient nominal gyro trim/remainder and metadata tests; no hardware or MCU execution

analyze-corrected-gyro.description: Verify original V2 corrected gyro sessions with explicit expected durations; report residuals/graphs without fitting another bias

check-gyro-selection.description: Offline selection boundary tests including a valid packet after timed recording; no board

record-angles.description: Historical V3 angle viewer; current FIFO firmware emits low-rate D diagnostics and uses record-1khz

check-tilt-observation.description: Nominal gravity geometry/signs and V3 protocol checks; no MCU execution

analyze-stationary.description: Verify actual stationary-intended IMU data, compute PC gravity tilt and covariance propagation; no refitting or hardware commands

analyze-repeatability.description: Verify three real 60-second recordings, quantify short-term repeatability and calculate sensor/bus/serial rate budgets; no firmware or calibration changes

record-1khz.description: Capture 20,000 FIFO samples, verify sequence/checksum and MCU calculations, retain timing/backlog evidence; no upload

check-1khz.description: Synthetic full-stream/fault protocol checks; not MCU timing or sensor execution

check-native-firmware.description: Execute actual main.cpp with fake peripherals using MSVC; not ESP32 emulation or physical timing

check-all.description: Run every unique offline bench test; --native also runs actual-source host fault tests; never opens serial or uploads

analyze-fifo.description: Replay complete and failed original FIFO trials and report actual integrity/timing

check-gyro-frame.description: Provisional rotation algebra/metadata tests; not physical gyro sign/scale validation

prepare-attitude.description: Offline noise/angle preparation from four saved FIFO runs plus a four-case model; requires fresh --output folder; no hardware

check-attitude.description: Six analytic offline filter/design tests; no serial, MCU or physical acceptance

knowledge.description: Project facts, evidence freshness, search and transactional local task reservations

check-knowledge.description: Check reservation conflicts/concurrency in a temporary database; no hardware

check-pcb-palette.description: Check module symbols/pads and UUID links with native KiCad; optional --project path; no physical-fit claim

check-connected-pcb.description: Validate connected I2C schematic and PCB pad nets, GPIO assignments and separate BEC links; no physical acceptance

check-home-etched-pcb.description: Native routed-board DRC and schematic/link connectivity; saves original evidence, never flashes

check-current-pcb.description: Native DRC/parity and common-GND graph through three dedicated two-hole wire jumpers; no flashing

render-pcb-3d.description: Native KiCad 3D renders with portable illustrative modules; original renderer logs; no electrical edits
